decision.criteria: Pass if at least one frog is visibly placed inside the toilet bowl. Fail if the images clearly show no frog placed inside the bowl. decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Use the source toilet to identify the bowl and determine whether a visible frog has been placed inside it. Assess only the requested bowl placement; do not infer additional placement requirements from frogs elsewhere.
